load_vqvae_model: load a VQVAE model from a checkpoint file along with its config.yaml
encode_speech_to_codes: encode speech features into discrete F0 codes using the VQVAE encoder and bottleneck
decode_codes_to_speech: decode discrete F0 codes back to continuous speech features using the VQVAE decoder
build_encoder_with_resnet1d: build a multi-level Encoder with Resnet1D blocks and configurable downsampling strides
build_decoder_with_skip_connections: build a multi-level Decoder with skip connections and transposed convolutions for upsampling
